# contentful_content_type (Data Source)

Retrieves a Contentful Content Type, including unactivated changes. See [Using environment aliases](../guides/existing-configuration#use-environment-aliases) for alias lookups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "contentful_content_type" "article" {
  space_id        = var.contentful_space_id
  environment_id  = var.contentful_environment_id
  content_type_id = var.contentful_content_type_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_type_id` (String) System ID of the content type.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment or environment alias.
- `space_id` (String) ID of the space.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the content type, or null when absent.
- `display_field` (String) Field ID used as the display field for entries, or null when unset.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Fields in the order returned by Contentful. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `id` (String) Composite Terraform identifier in `space_id/environment_id/content_type_id` form.
- `metadata` (Attributes) Content Type annotations and taxonomy, or null when absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `name` (String) Name of the content type.
- `published_version` (Number) Contentful version most recently activated, or null when not returned.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_resources` (Attributes List) Allowed resources for a Resource Link field, or null when absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--allowed_resources))
- `default_value` (String) Normalized JSON object of locale defaults, or null when absent.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the field is hidden in the entry editor.
- `id` (String) ID of the field within the content type.
- `items` (Attributes) Array item type and validations, or null for other fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--items))
- `link_type` (String) Linked resource type for a Link field, or null when absent.
- `localized` (Boolean) Whether the field supports localized values.
- `name` (String) Name of the field.
- `omitted` (Boolean) Whether the field is omitted from Delivery and Preview responses.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether an Entry needs a value before publication.
- `type` (String) Contentful field type.
- `validations` (List of String) Ordered field validation rules as normalized JSON strings.

<a id="nestedatt--fields--allowed_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.allowed_resources`

Read-Only:

- `contentful_entry` (Attributes) Allowed Contentful entry resource, or null for an external resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--allowed_resources--contentful_entry))
- `external` (Attributes) Allowed external resource, or null for Contentful entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--allowed_resources--external))

<a id="nestedatt--fields--allowed_resources--contentful_entry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.allowed_resources.contentful_entry`

Read-Only:

- `content_types` (List of String) Allowed content type IDs.
- `source` (String) Source of the allowed Contentful entries.


<a id="nestedatt--fields--allowed_resources--external"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.allowed_resources.external`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) External resource type.



<a id="nestedatt--fields--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.items`

Read-Only:

- `link_type` (String) Linked resource type for Link items, or null when absent.
- `type` (String) Array item type, or null when absent.
- `validations` (List of String) Ordered array-item validation rules as normalized JSON strings.



<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Read-Only:

- `annotations` (String) Normalized JSON annotations, or null when absent.
- `taxonomy` (Attributes List) Taxonomy concept and concept scheme links in returned order, or null when absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--taxonomy))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata--taxonomy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.taxonomy`

Read-Only:

- `taxonomy_concept` (Attributes) Taxonomy concept link, or null for a concept scheme. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--taxonomy--taxonomy_concept))
- `taxonomy_concept_scheme` (Attributes) Taxonomy concept scheme link, or null for a concept. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--taxonomy--taxonomy_concept_scheme))

### Nested Schema for `metadata.taxonomy.taxonomy_concept`

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--metadata--taxonomy--taxonomy_concept_scheme"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.taxonomy.taxonomy_concept_scheme`
